title: Small surface structures
body:
WHAT??

![image: Small surface structures](media/1437479950193266789.png)

Full-sized structures haven't been implemented yet, but small surface structures have been added. Some strange force seems to keep them perpetually dark, even during the day.

Slimes and Ghouls can now also spawn from spawners. *(You don't know what Ghouls are, though...)*

![image: Small surface structures](media/1437483673074274334.png)
